title: The Safe Room Rules | Renderer Test

scenes.title: The Door
scenes.caption: Evan wakes to a heavy knock from the other side of the safe room.

scenes.title: The New Rule
scenes.caption: A sheet of metal appears where the old warning used to be.
scenes.text:
RULE 3
NEVER OPEN THE DOOR AFTER MIDNIGHT.

scenes.title: The Countdown
scenes.caption: The clock shows 11:59. The knocking stops.

scenes.title: The Last Knock
scenes.caption: Then a voice whispers from inside the room: I am already here.
